source.note: Traveler (anemo) — one character per element; both twins map here. Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets + allStat_gen skillParam at Lv10. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Enka ingestion maps avatarId 10000005/10000007 + skillDepotId to this synthetic avatar_id. Unparsed GO formulas: ['burst.absorb: skipped (helper/cond formula)', 'skill.initial_ele_dmg: skipped (helper/cond formula)', 'skill.max_ele_dmg: skipped (helper/cond formula)', 'skill.storm_ele_dmg: skipped (helper/cond formula)', 'skill.storm_ele_max: skipped (helper/cond formula)']. ADDITIONAL BUFF EFFECTS, added 2026-08-14: the quest-unlocked passive 'Foreign Windwrath' (nanoka passives[].unlock [603101]; the stat list itself lives in the in-game glossary, nanoka hyperlink.json entry 10050001, NOT in the passive's own description) grants the Traveler one permanent stat bonus PER ELEMENT THEY HAVE RESONATED WITH: Anemo +10% CRIT Rate, Geo +20% DEF, Electro +20% Energy Recharge, Dendro +60 Elemental Mastery, Hydro +20% HP, Pyro +20% ATK, Cryo +20% CRIT DMG — the same seven values are param[0..6] of every Traveler's Foreign passive. All seven are seeded unconditionally in self_modifiers_json, i.e. ASSUMING A FULLY-RESONATED ACCOUNT: Enka exposes neither the resonance list nor whether the passive is unlocked, so there is nothing to gate on. (fightPropMap does include passive stat bonuses — Kokomi's -100% CRIT Rate shows up there — but the evaluator rebuilds stats from sources via build_base_stats_from_sources and never reads fightPropMap, which is why every unconditional passive stat effect has to be seeded like this.) NOT MODELLED: the same passive's special Charged Attack: Whirlwind (+60% ATK on each CA hit, plus one 50%-ATK elemental Blade Wind per consumed Blade of the Dawn Breeze stack, once per 15s) — a separate damage instance that would need its own hit definitions. QUEST BASE-STAT BONUSES, added 2026-08-14: base_stats_json above is deliberately NOT the raw game curve value. The Traveler carries three permanent quest rewards: +3 Base ATK from Activated Canned Knowledge (Archon Quest Ch. III Act I 'Ever So Close', step 5) and +7 Base ATK / +15 Elemental Mastery / +50 Base HP from Special Training in Skirk's Story Quest (Crystallina Ch. Act I, steps 2/6/9). So baseAtk 212.397192 -> 222.397192, baseHp 10874.914859 -> 10924.914859, and baseEleMas 15 (the only character in this seed set with a non-zero base EM). Verified against Enka: over all 338 level-90 builds in the local DB, the Traveler is the ONLY character whose fightPropMap base HP differs from its seed (by exactly +50.00), whose base-ATK residual exceeds weapon mainStatValue display rounding (+9.66), or whose EM carries an unexplained +15. These are flat and level-independent, so scale_base_stats_to_level will scale them by ~1.7% too much on a level-100 board (0.17 ATK / 0.85 HP) -- not worth a special case. DO NOT 'correct' these back to the nanoka/Amber curve values: the base-stat audit script will flag all seven travelers for exactly this.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C2 Uprising Whirlwind: increases the Traveler's Energy Recharge by 16%. Unconditional once the constellation is owned, so it is a single always-on state gated on C2.

A1 Slitting Wind: the last hit of a Normal Attack combo unleashes a wind blade dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG to all opponents in its path. The evaluator has no hit-specific flat-ATK-ratio key (normal_dmgIncFromAtk_ applies uniformly to every Normal Attack hit in the combo, not just the last), so this is approximated by spreading the 60% ATK bonus evenly across all 5 Normal Attack hits (0.60 / 5 = 0.12 ATK-ratio per hit); accurate for full 5-hit combo rotations, will misestimate for partial combos.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C6 Intertwined Winds: targets that take DMG from the Elemental Burst Gust Surge have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%. The burst also decreases RES to its absorbed element by the same 20% — pick the state matching the element the vortex absorbed, since a leaderboard scenario knows which team it is run in.

auto.name: Foreign Ironwind
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Palm Vortex
skill.desc: Grasping the wind's might, you form a vortex of vacuum in your palm, causing continuous Anemo DMG to opponents in front of you. The vacuum vortex explodes when the skill duration ends, causing a greater amount of Anemo DMG over a larger area. Hold DMG and AoE will gradually increase. Elemental Absorption If the vortex comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type. Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use. You discussed the way to grasp the formless wind with Paimon.

burst.name: Gust Surge
burst.desc: Guiding the path of the wind currents, you summon a forward-moving tornado that pulls objects and opponents towards itself, dealing continuous Anemo DMG. Elemental Absorption If the tornado comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type. Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use. You and Paimon studied the flapping of a butterfly's wings.

passives.name: Slitting Wind
passives.desc: The last hit of a Normal Attack combo unleashes a wind blade, dealing 60% of ATK as <e:anemo>Anemo DMG</e> to all opponents in its path.

passives.name: Second Wind
passives.desc:
<k>Palm Vortex</k> kills regenerate 2% HP for 5s.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

passives.name: Foreign Windwrath
passives.desc:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional <k>buffs</k>.

Additionally, when <e:pyro>Pyro</e>, <e:hydro>Hydro</e>, <e:cryo>Cryo</e>, or <e:electro>Electro</e> attacks from nearby party members hit opponents, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of the Dawn Breeze. Each Elemental Type can grant 1 Blade of the Dawn Breeze stack. After obtaining at least 2 stacks of Blade of the Dawn Breeze, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of the Dawn Breeze and transform into the special <k>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</k>.

<k>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</k>
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased <e:anemo>Anemo DMG</e>. Increase in DMG is equal to 60% of Traveler's ATK.
· Every time a Blade of the Dawn Breeze of a certain elemental type is consumed, a Blade Wind matching this elemental type will also be summoned, dealing elemental DMG equal to 50% of Traveler's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· <k>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</k> can be triggered up to once every 15s.
· For the duration of <k>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</k>, no Blade of the Dawn Breeze will be obtained.

constellations.name: Raging Vortex
constellations.desc: <k>Palm Vortex</k> pulls in opponents and objects within a 5m radius.

constellations.name: Sweeping Gust
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Gust Surge</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Cherishing Breezes
constellations.desc: Reduces DMG taken while casting <k>Palm Vortex</k> by 10%.

constellations.name: Vortex Stellaris
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Palm Vortex</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Intertwined Winds
constellations.desc:
Targets who take DMG from <k>Gust Surge</k> have their <e:anemo>Anemo RES</e> decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

auto.name: Vents de la discorde
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour déclencher deux coups d'épée rapides.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Vortex destructeur
skill.desc: Un vortex de vent, tournant et tranchant, se forme dans la paume de votre main, infligeant des DGT Anémo continus aux ennemis en face. Le vortex finit par exploser à la fin de la compétence, l'explosion couvrant une zone plus large et infligeant des DGT Anémo plus importants. Appui long Augmente les DGT et la zone d'effet. Absorption élémentaire Le vortex absorbe les éléments Hydro, Pyro, Cryo et Électro avec lesquels il entre en contact, ceux-ci conférant un bonus de DGT de l'élément correspondant. Une seule réaction d'absorption élémentaire peut avoir lieu par utilisation. Vous avez discuté de la maîtrise de vos nouveaux pouvoirs Anémo avec Paimon.

burst.name: Rafale de vent
burst.desc: Vous invoquez une tornade qui attire les objets et les ennemis en avançant, et qui inflige des DGT Anémo continus. Absorption élémentaire La tornade absorbe les éléments Hydro, Pyro, Cryo et Électro avec lesquels elle entre en contact, ceux-ci conférant leurs attributs et infligeant un bonus de DGT de l'élément correspondant. Un seul élément peut être absorbé à la fois. Paimon et vous avez étudié les battements qui agitent les ailes des papillons...

passives.name: Vent du ciel déchiré
passives.desc: Le dernier coup d'attaque normale libère une lame de vent, qui inflige une quantité de <e:anemo>DGT Anémo</e> équivalant à 60 % de l'ATQ aux ennemis sur sa route.

passives.name: Vent de guérison
passives.desc:
<k>Vortex destructeur</k> restaure 2 % des PV toutes les secondes pendant 5 s lorsqu'il élimine un ennemi.
Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 5 s.

passives.name: Bourrasque d'ailleurs
passives.desc:
Permet au voyageur de puiser une force nouvelle dans ses périples passés, lui accordant un <k>effet de renforcement</k> supplémentaire pour chaque élément avec lequel il est entré en résonance.

De plus, lorsque l'attaque d'un personnage de l'équipe à proximité de type <e:pyro>Pyro</e>, <e:hydro>Hydro</e>, <e:cryo>Cryo</e> ou <e:electro>Électro</e> touche un ennemi, le voyageur obtient 1 lame de brise matinale de l'élément correspondant, chaque élément pouvant accorder 1 lame. Avec au moins 2 lames de brise matinale, effectuer une attaque chargée consomme toutes les lames pour déclencher une <k>attaque chargée « Tourbillon »</k> spéciale.

<k>Attaque chargée « Tourbillon »</k>
· Chaque coup de l'attaque chargée inflige des <e:anemo>DGT Anémo</e> qui sont augmentés d'une valeur équivalant à 60 % de l'ATQ du voyageur.
· Consommer une lame de brise matinale d'un certain type élémentaire génère un vent de lame de l'élément correspondant qui inflige des DGT élémentaires d'une valeur équivalant à 50 % de l'ATQ du voyageur, ces DGT étant considérés comme des DGT d'attaque chargée.
· Une <k>attaque chargée « Tourbillon »</k> peut être déclenchée une fois toutes les 15 s.
· Il est impossible d'obtenir des lames de brise matinale pendant une <k>attaque chargée « Tourbillon »</k>.

constellations.name: Vortex déchaîné
constellations.desc: <k>Vortex destructeur</k> attire les ennemis et les objets dans un rayon de 5 mètres autour du personnage.

constellations.name: Rafale de balayage
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Rafale de vent</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Prévenance de brise
constellations.desc: Les DGT subis diminuent de 10 % tant que <k>Vortex destructeur</k> est actif.

constellations.name: Vents enlacés
constellations.desc:
La <e:anemo>RÉS Anémo</e> des ennemis touchés par <k>Rafale de vent</k> diminue de 20 %.
En cas d'absorption élémentaire, leur RÉS à l'élément correspondant diminue également de 20 %.
